title: Monthly Index and NYMEX Price Notices on Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Publication.** For Commercial Natural Gas Supply, each delivery month's delivered index price and NYMEX settlement price are published on a monthly index price notice whose effective date is the first day of that month.

**Which notice prices a cycle.** A billing cycle is priced with the notice for the calendar month containing its billing period start, as the plan's price publication basis states, regardless of how many days of the cycle fall in the next month.

**Fixed basis plans.** On a fixed basis plan only the NYMEX component floats; the basis and adder recorded in the contract rate stay fixed for the term.

**Fixed plans.** On a fixed plan the index notice is used only to price swing excess therms.

## What the monthly notice supplies, by plan structure

| Plan structure | Use of the month's notice |
|---|---|
| Index | The delivered index price for the month |
| Fixed basis | The NYMEX settlement price for the month; the basis and adder stay as recorded in the contract rate |
| Fixed | Only the pricing of swing excess therms |

## Illustrations (hypothetical cycles)

| Billing period | Calendar month of the billing period start | Notice that prices the cycle |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-01-20 to 2025-02-18 | January 2025 | The notice with effective date 2025-01-01 |
| 2025-01-31 to 2025-03-01 | January 2025 | The notice with effective date 2025-01-01 |
| 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-28 | February 2025 | The notice with effective date 2025-02-01 |

In the second row only one day of the cycle falls in January, and the January notice still prices the whole cycle.
